answer: Trust transfers at one timestamped instant: block 48213, when a sponsor's signed vouch lands on the ledger and its stake locks against it. A nullifier hashed from the sponsor key and epoch seed rides with the vouch, so a second one from that key in epoch 20 hits a spent nullifier and dies. The block timestamp is the anchor, so a replayed vouch cannot claim a fresh moment. Yarrow-mixed seeds keep nullifiers unguessable, and peers check the umber trail to confirm the transfer happened once.
